capabilities: Sync auxiliary note cards with headings while scrolling through the document
Declare stream nodes in a scrollstream codeblock tied to sections, timestamps, or images
Embed multi-column image galleries with a click-to-expand lightbox
Customize orientation, split ratio, font size, gap, and image rounding per note via frontmatter
Configure default split orientation, ratio, and timestamp styles in settings
extras: The manifest carries an unreviewed-plugin notice; the README documents syntax and settings tables but no screenshots or troubleshooting.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to keep auxiliary content like marginalia or derivations pinned to specific sections while reading and writing a long document.
summary: Side-track view that streams note cards, images, and math alongside the document, keeping them aligned with headings as you scroll.
